text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser has just completed
her full
training regimen, when...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! I want to run for a bit
longer today!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Fuku told me that my lucky item today is
the
moon!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I think I might get some kind of amazing
power if
I run at night! This is my big
chance to go beyond
my ordinary self!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Get ready to see my moonlight
powerup!
choice_data_list: Do your best to take that next step!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Up, up, and away I go! Ei, ei, mun! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser happily continues
running
well into the night.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hrm... But if the power comes from
moonlight...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, now that you mention it, she never
said I had
to run.
choice_data_list: Is just looking at the moon not enough?
Is just looking at the moon not enough?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll just gaze at the moon
from my
room tonight until I'm full of
power!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that decided, Matikanetannhauser
returns
to her dorm.
